title: 微观经济学导论：模型、简化假设与供需
titleEn: Intro to Micro: Models, Simplifying Assumptions, and Supply-Demand

sections.heading: 课程定位与经济学方法

items.text: 现代经济学诞生于MIT，核心工具是约束最优化。
items.textEn: Modern economics was developed at MIT through constrained-optimization tools.

items.text: 经济学用简化模型描述两个或多个变量之间的关系；经济学没有普适科学定律，属于社会科学。
items.textEn: Economics uses simplified models: descriptions of relationships among variables, without universal constants.

sections.heading: 简化假设：解释力与可教性的权衡

items.text: 建模要在“尽可能解释世界”和“模型简洁、可教可解”之间权衡。
items.textEn: We trade off explaining the world against parsimonious models that are teachable and solvable.

items.text: 看似强的假设：只写两种商品；其直觉可推广到n种商品，且数学更简单。
items.textEn: Assume two goods: two-good intuition extends to n goods with easier math.

items.text: 有些假设会引起反感；检验放松这些假设正是继续修经济学的原因。
items.textEn: Some assumptions are offensive; testing them is why you become an economics major.

items.text: 统计学家George Box名言：所有模型都是错的，但有些是有用的。
items.textEn: George Box: all models are wrong, but some are useful.

items.text: 学好本课需同时掌握数学、图形和直觉三种表达方式。
items.textEn: Master mathematical, graphical, and intuitive levels to succeed.

sections.heading: 首个模型：供需与亚当·斯密
sections.headingEn: First Model: Supply-Demand and Adam Smith

items.text: 亚当·斯密在1776年《国富论》中奠定经济学，以供需模型解释价格。
items.textEn: Adam Smith introduced supply and demand in The Wealth of Nations (1776).

items.text: 水对生命极重要、需求巨大却几乎免费；钻石非必需却价格高昂。
items.textEn: Water is essential with huge demand, yet nearly free; diamonds are luxuries yet costly.

items.text: 价格由需求与供给共同决定：水供给极丰裕，钻石稀缺。
items.textEn: Price depends on both demand and supply: water is abundant, diamonds are rare.
